scenario: [LTAC.2.2.1] / [LRST.1.1] — `as`-keyed supersedure SUPERSEDES. Pin: two DISTINCT Req facts (different `entity_id`, so the logical upsert does not collapse them) each arm a 100ms timer carrying the SAME evaluated key `r.grp`. The second arming must retract the first, so advancing past the delay fires the after-body EXACTLY ONCE. NB the vehicle is log_message_sequence, not event_sequence: arming a timer emits NO fact_assert (only the two Req asserts appear in the stream), so supersedure is invisible to an expected_kinds match. log_message_sequence is exact list equality. This is the String half; the non-String half is `logical/LTAC.2.2.1_as_keyed_supersedure_int`.
rules_ds:
schema Req scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    grp: String mutable

rule arm:
    Req r
->
    log info "armed"
    after 100ms as r.grp:
        log info "timer fired"
